name: Permissions filtered by modules
project_description:
This module provides lightweight filters for module list and roles list at the top of the Permissions page for easier management when your site has a large amount of roles and/or permissions.

 This module don't override core path or core permissions form. It simple provides own form with ajaxify filters for permissions administration process.

 Optional integration with Permissions dragcheck: 
 Provides highlight, click & drag functionality for checkboxes on the permissions page to administer permissions faster and easier.

See a demo and more complex example here . 

 Alternatives: 
 Fast permissions administration (FPA) module + Filter permissions (filter_perms)
